caption: This pencil drawing depicts a mechanical object with a large, circular, slightly concave disk at its center, behind a rounded apparatus with a spout-like extension and two cylindrical rods angled from the top. The disk has a small loop or handle at its top. The cylindrical rods are detailed with textured grips. An attached ring, likely for mounting or holding, is depicted at the bottom right of the main apparatus. The entire object is rendered in grayscale with shading to suggest metal forms and highlights for dimensionality. At the upper left of the page, there is a smaller, inset diagram showing a side elevation view of the object, including dimension lines and measurement markings. The background is plain, emphasizing the technical and mechanical details of the depicted object. The artist's name, "IRVING D. GEHIN," is written in the bottom right corner of the main drawing.
title: Lamp
